quick_skim.title: Lunar Surface Receiver Clock Synchronization Using GNSS and Satellite Nadir Angle
quick_skim.abstract: The use of signals from Earth-orbiting Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) constellations for positioning, navigation, and timing on the lunar surface was recently demonstrated by the Lunar GNSS Receiver Experiment (LuGRE) aboard Blue Ghost Mission 1. For receiver clock synchronization using GNSS, Kalman filter performance depends on the satellite-specific measurement uncertainty used to construct the measurement noise covariance. Terrestrial measurement weighting commonly relies on receiver elevation angle, but the elevation angles in the analyzed LuGRE data are confined to 24.2-31.5 degrees, providing limited discrimination of measurement quality. In contrast, satellite nadir angles span 12.1-66.6 degrees, and the measurement variability increases substantially at small nadir angles. Based on this observation, we propose a measurement weighting model that combines satellite nadir angle with C/N0 for lunar surface receiver clock synchronization. The proposed model is evaluated against three weighting methods adopted from the literature using seven LuGRE operation periods (OPs). It achieves the lowest receiver clock bias root mean square error (RMSE) in six of the seven OPs and an overall RMSE of 5.78 m, which is 19.5% lower than that of the best comparison model. The proposed model also provides the lowest clock bias prediction RMSE under simulated measurement outages.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 该文针对月球表面GNSS接收机钟差同步中测量加权困难的问题：传统按接收机仰角加权，但LuGRE实测仰角仅覆盖24.2至31.5度，难以区分测量质量。作者改以卫星天底角构造测量噪声协方差，天底角范围达12.1至66.6度，具有更强的区分度。基于LuGRE数据的分析表明该加权方式能改善卡尔曼滤波钟差同步性能。该工作为地月空间GNSS定位授时与多源测量融合提供了可迁移的加权与融合思路。

quick_skim.title: OrbitTAMP: Grounding Language Models for Task and Motion Planning in Spacecraft Rendezvous
quick_skim.abstract: Spacecraft rendezvous and proximity operations (RPO) are currently planned through an expertise-intensive process in which engineers translate high-level operational intent into safe, dynamically feasible trajectories, creating a bottleneck to scalable operations. Large language model (LLM)-based agents could offer an intuitive interface for this process, although their outputs are not inherently grounded in orbital dynamics, operational constraints, or the structure of admissible spacecraft maneuvers. To exploit their semantic reasoning while ensuring the generated plan's physical validity, this paper presents a hierarchical framework for spacecraft task-and-motion planning (TAMP) that grounds LLM reasoning in a graph of reusable behaviors and domain-specific planning modules. Within this framework, a pretrained LLM maps a natural-language command to a partial mission specification. The associated planners then resolve unspecified decisions within the admissible operational space. Finally, trajectory optimization converts the completed mission specification into a dynamically feasible trajectory. Numerical experiments demonstrate that this architecture substantially improves intent recovery over direct LLM generation, achieving 98% exact recovery of partial mission specifications across all evaluated splits when backed by frontier LLMs. Additional test-time-compute experiments show that, for a compact 9B model, verifier-guided revision increases exact recovery from 75% to 88%, while broader behavior-plan search independently improves selection among admissible trajectory realizations. Overall, these results establish a scalable and auditable foundation for language-driven agentic planning of spacecraft RPO.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Spacecraft rendezvous planning relies on experts to convert intent into safe trajectories, bottlenecking scalability; this paper presents a hierarchical task-and-motion planning framework that grounds LLM reasoning in reusable maneuver graphs and orbital dynamics to produce physically valid proximity-operation plans.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 航天器交会与接近操作目前依赖专家将高层意图手工转化为安全轨迹，成为规模化操作的瓶颈。本文提出分层任务与运动规划框架，把大语言模型的语义推理锚定在可复用机动图与轨道动力学约束中，以保证生成规划物理可行。在交会接近场景中该方法能生成满足操作约束的机动方案，展示了语言模型与轨道规划结合用于空间自主操作的潜力。
